_note: Copy the prices_per_mtok block into config.json (close the dashboard first). USD per million tokens, by model family. Fable and Opus input, output and cache-read rates were taken from Anthropic's published pricing in Nov 2026; the Sonnet and Haiku cache rates are assumed (cache read = 10% of input, cache write = 1.25x input). Check https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing before relying on any of it, because prices change. Haiku 5.5 costs more above 100K-token prompts; this uses the lower rate.
